name: Get attachments for label
description: Get attachments for label Returns the attachments of specified label. GET /wiki/api/v2/labels/{id}/attachments
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/labels/{id}/attachments
Returns the attachments of specified label. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the attachment and its corresponding space.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the label for which attachments should be returned.
Optional: sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of pages per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get labels
description: Get labels Returns all labels. GET /wiki/api/v2/labels
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/labels
Returns all labels. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission). Only labels that the user has permission to view will be returned.
Optional: label-id (query) — Filters on label ID. Multiple IDs can be specified as a comma-separated list.; prefix (query) — Filters on label prefix. Multiple IDs can be specified as a comma-separated list.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; limit (query) — Maximum number of labels per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.
